A fancy rat will be your new scouting buddy. It will not fight or help with livestock, but it notices trouble further out than almost anything else in the mod and is the quietest about it. Strays turn up in houses, farm buildings, and anywhere cluttered or grubby. Warehouses, kitchens, storage rooms, basements.

Hold an item and the rat memorizes it. Every time you sleep it goes out looking on its own and can come back with one, stowed in the saddlebags. Once a day, and the rarer the item the longer it takes. Needs saddlebags.
